name: maiolica
description: Maiolica: gioco di piastrelle per 2-4 giocatori, web e self-hosted

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @maiolica/server & npm run dev -w @maiolica/client
scripts.build: npm run build -w @maiolica/client && npm run build -w @maiolica/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/client
